name: Isolated Congenital Auditory Ossicle Malformation

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for Isolated Congenital Auditory Ossicle Malformation

criteria.description: Presence of congenital conductive hearing loss confirmed by audiometry
Radiological evidence of malformation or absence of one or more auditory ossicles on high-resolution CT scan
No associated external ear or cochlear malformations (isolated ossicular anomaly)
Normal facial nerve function without palsy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital conductive hearing loss with radiological confirmation of ossicular malformation in the absence of other middle or inner ear anomalies
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of syndromic causes and other ear malformations.

searchTerms: hearing loss from middle ear problems

pathognomonic.symptomName: Ossicular chain discontinuity or malformation detected on imaging
searchTerms: middle ear bone abnormalities on scan
ossicle chain defects seen on imaging

common.symptomName: Impaired sound conduction with normal cochlear function
searchTerms: sound doesn't pass well to inner ear

common.symptomName: Speech delay secondary to hearing impairment
searchTerms: late talking due to hearing impairment

occasional.symptomName: Tympanic membrane abnormalities (e.g., retraction or scarring)

searchTerms: ear fluid buildup on and off

rare.notes: Rarely associated due to proximity of facial nerve

imaging: High-resolution computed tomography (CT) scan showing malformation, fixation, or absence of malleus, incus, or stapes
Normal cochlear and external auditory canal anatomy on imaging
genetic: No consistent genetic mutations identified; typically sporadic isolated malformation
other: Audiometric testing demonstrating conductive hearing loss with normal bone conduction thresholds

distinguishingFeatures: Syndromic features involving other organ systems
Progressive conductive hearing loss in adolescence or adulthood
Radiological evidence of stapes footplate fixation

redFlags: Progressive hearing loss beyond early childhood
